Q: Is something wrong with zeros or multiple pairs in stroke-dasharray? A:

The answers by Mike and enxaneta mention two things:

  • The sum of dashes and gaps can be slightly bigger than the circumference, and push the last zero-dash beyond the end.

  • So can the dash offset.

My observation is, that the latter is more important.

The example given by enxaneta works:

stroke-dashoffset="-293.214"
stroke-dasharray="0 146.607 293.214 146.607 0 146.607 0 146.607"

The sum of the dashes and gaps is 879.642 — slightly below 2·π·140.

The unit 146.607 is exactly that sum divided by 6.

The positive equivalent of that offset is 586.428 (4 units).

With offsets 586.429 ... 586.654 the right circle disappears.

That range corresponds to a length of 0.226.

Offsets 0.001 ... 0.226 have the same effect.

I was wrong with my assumption, that the problem does not appear for the simpler pattern, as seen in the code sample below. Here the right circle disappears for offsets 0.001 ... 0.915.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="-50 -50 300 300">
  
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="100" 
          stroke-dasharray="0 78.539"
          stroke-dashoffset="0.001"
          style="fill: none; stroke-width: 76.536686473; stroke: purple; stroke-linecap: round;"
  />

</svg>

This simply seems to boil down to the fact, that around there is a small danger zone after the origin on the right. When a dash disappears in it, then its linecaps do as well. I see no way to calculate its length.

Q: XAMPP: "httpd.exe - Entry Point Not Found" Error A:

I face the same problem, following solution works for me.

  1. Download portable xampp.
  2. Extract the folder and copy httpd.exe file from apache/bin folder and paste in your installed xampp/apache/bin folder.
  3. Re-open xampp control panel and start apache.

Hope it works for you too.
